entities.summary: Choisy Cathedral, also known as the Church of St. Louis and St. Nicholas, is a Roman Catholic church located in Choisy-le-Roi, France. From 1966, when the diocese was established, to 1987, when the present Créteil Cathedral was inaugurated, it served as the first cathedral of the diocese of Créteil.
